Before you begin

Questions, answered.

Do I need any equipment?

No. Every workout is bodyweight-only. A comfortable floor or exercise mat is helpful.

Does this work for beginners?

Yes. The challenge is built for all levels, with modifications where needed. Move at your own pace and prioritize form.

How long are the workouts?

The planned videos are approximately 10 to 14 minutes. Exact lengths will be added to each day after filming.

How long will I have access?

Access length will be confirmed before checkout opens. Add the final policy here before launch.

What is the refund policy?

The final refund terms will be shown clearly at checkout and on the Terms page before launch.

About & policies

About this course

Eliana Sue creates short, control-focused ab workouts designed to make consistency feel approachable. These programs are educational fitness resources, not individualized medical advice.

Fitness disclaimer

Check with a qualified healthcare professional before starting a new exercise program, especially if you are pregnant, postpartum, injured, managing a medical condition, or returning after time away. Stop immediately if you feel pain, dizziness, shortness of breath beyond normal exercise, or anything that feels wrong. Choose the modification that fits your body and never force a movement.
